keyPoints: Parimey sankhya (rational number) p/q ke roop me likhi jaati hai jahan q shunya nahi — 3/4, -2/5, 7 sab parimey hain.
Har parimey sankhya ka manak roop (standard form) hota hai jisme har dhanaatmak aur ansh-har me 1 ke siva koi common gunankhand nahi — jaise 4/6 ka manak roop 2/3 hai.
Sankhya rekha par parimey sankhyaen bhi dikhayi ja sakti hain — 0 ke bayen rinatmak, dayen dhanaatmak.
Parimey sankhyaon ka jod-ghata bhinnon jaisa hi hai — pehle har same karo: 2/3 + (-1/4) = 8/12 - 3/12 = 5/12.
Guna me ansh x ansh, har x har; bhaag me bhajak ka vyutkram (reciprocal) lekar guna karo.
Do parimey sankhyaon ke beech anant parimey sankhyaen hoti hain — ausat lekar nayi sankhya mil jaati hai.
Aam galti: rinatmak parimey sankhyaon ki tulna me chihn bhool jana — -1/2, -1/3 se chhota hai kyunki sankhya rekha par ye 0 se door hai.
